asset.Name: Research Test
asset.Description:
Development test, not meant for publishing. Requires a new campaign.

Adds three research projects, available from the start:
- MOD TEST: Dummy Research: no effect.
- MOD TEST: Reinforced Airframe: replaces the passive armour regeneration item of every interceptor with a reinforced version that adds 50 hull points.
- MOD TEST: Heavy Plating: unlocks the Heavy Plating Mk1 engineering project ($50,000). Heavy Plating is an alternative to Ablative Plating: Mk1-Mk4 give 12 / 18 / 24 / 30 Armour (Ablative 6 / 12 / 18 / 24) and +50 / 75 / 100 / 125 hull points, but payload 5 instead of 3 and 10% slower in air combat. Mk2-Mk4 unlock after the standard armour upgrade of the same tier and upgrade the plating already fitted. It uses its own icon, a recoloured Ablative Plating.

It checks whether mods can add new research, engineering projects, equippable items and images.
